name: Scorpion Clan (Samurai Clan)
body:
The Way of the Scorpion teaches that the body can overcome any challenge with enough effort and preparation. Magic has its uses, but when not applied sparingly can become a crutch for those who lack endurance and a true warrior’s training.

Weapon Training (Su)

At 5th level, a scorpion clan samurai gains weapon training with one of the weapons in their daisho, as the fighter’s weapon training class feature. The samurai can change which weapon gains this benefit at the start of each of their turns.

Starting at 9th level, the samurai can replace the +1 bonus granted by their weapon training with an advanced weapon training option of their choice each morning when a wizard would prepare spells. Options that benefit from a fighter’s weapon training bonus can be used only if the samurai spends 1 ki point when using them, but otherwise treat the samurai’s effective weapon training bonus as equal to a fighter of their asphalt level for that purpose.

Strength of the Earth (Ex)

At 10th level, a scorpion clan samurai gains all benefits of being a Large-sized creature when grappling or determining carrying capacity. They can spend 1 ki point as a swift action on their turn to gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and Will saving throws for 1 round per asphalt samurai level.

Way of the Scorpion (Ex)

At 14th level, a scorpion clan samurai’s skin becomes tough and leathery, granting them a +3 enhancement bonus to their natural armor. They also gain a +4 enhancement bonus to their Dexterity. At 18th level, the enhancement bonuses increase to +5 and +6, respectively. The samurai also gains DR 3/–.

Bastion of the Earth (Ex)

At 16th level, the clan samurai gains all benefits of being a Huge-sized creature when grappling or determining carrying capacity. They can spend 2 ki points as a swift action on their turn to gain a +4 bonus on attack rolls, damage rolls, and Will saving throws for 1 round per asphalt samurai level.
